scope: Retain evolution time 22, approximation target 1e-7, all 100 points from zero to one and both approximation/error panels. This is a classical polynomial workflow, not a quantum circuit. Native Torch cosine projection and Clenshaw evaluation replace external polynomial helpers. A conservative Bernstein-ellipse bound selects degree 49; the Classiq degree-selection policy is not reproduced. The exact-coefficient truncation bound and measured floating-point/quadrature error are reported separately. A 75-digit independent Decimal Bessel series checks coefficients, and 4097 points check actual error on [-1,1].
